bgltp_mine_diff_prog_effect = {
	set_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_found value = 0 }
	bgltp_mine_dp_shared_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { leader_class = commander } bgltp_mine_dp_cmd_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { leader_class = scientist } bgltp_mine_dp_sci_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { leader_class = official } bgltp_mine_dp_off_effect = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_found value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { leader_class = commander } } bgltp_mine_dp_cmd_effect = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { leader_class = scientist } } bgltp_mine_dp_sci_effect = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { leader_class = official } } bgltp_mine_dp_off_effect = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_found value = 0 } }
		root = { change_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_seq value = 1 } }
		log = "BGLTP_MINE seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] skill=[This.GetSkill] trait=NONE"
	}
}

	bgltp_mine_readd_shared_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { leader_class = commander } bgltp_mine_readd_cmd_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { leader_class = scientist } bgltp_mine_readd_sci_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { leader_class = official } bgltp_mine_readd_off_effect = yes }
}

bgltp_mine_diff_existing_clean_effect = {
	set_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_found value = 0 }
	bgltp_mine_dec_shared_effect = yes
	if = { limit = { leader_class = commander } bgltp_mine_dec_cmd_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { leader_class = scientist } bgltp_mine_dec_sci_effect = yes }
	else_if = { limit = { leader_class = official } bgltp_mine_dec_off_effect = yes }
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_found value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { leader_class = commander } } bgltp_mine_dec_cmd_effect = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { leader_class = scientist } } bgltp_mine_dec_sci_effect = yes }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { leader_class = official } } bgltp_mine_dec_off_effect = yes }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_found value = 0 } }
		root = { change_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_seq value = 1 } }
		log = "BGLTP_MINE seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] skill=[This.GetSkill] trait=NONE"
	}
	bgltp_mine_readd_missing_orig_effect = yes
}

bgltp_mine_restore_skill_effect = {
	if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_orig_skill value <= 1 } } set_skill = 1 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_orig_skill value = 2 } } set_skill = 2 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_orig_skill value = 3 } } set_skill = 3 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_orig_skill value = 4 } } set_skill = 4 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_orig_skill value = 5 } } set_skill = 5 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_orig_skill value = 6 } } set_skill = 6 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_orig_skill value = 7 } } set_skill = 7 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_orig_skill value = 8 } } set_skill = 8 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_orig_skill value = 9 } } set_skill = 9 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_orig_skill value = 10 } } set_skill = 10 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_orig_skill value = 11 } } set_skill = 11 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_orig_skill value = 12 } } set_skill = 12 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_orig_skill value = 13 } } set_skill = 13 }
	else_if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_orig_skill value = 14 } } set_skill = 14 }
	else = { set_skill = 15 }
	clear_variable = bgltp_mine_orig_skill
}

bgltp_mine_cleanup_existing_effect = {
	bgltp_mine_restore_skill_effect = yes
	bgltp_mine_clr_strip_shared_effect = yes
	bgltp_mine_clr_strip_cmd_effect = yes
	bgltp_mine_clr_strip_sci_effect = yes
	bgltp_mine_clr_strip_off_effect = yes
	bgltp_mine_clr_restore_shared_effect = yes
	bgltp_mine_clr_restore_cmd_effect = yes
	bgltp_mine_clr_restore_sci_effect = yes
	bgltp_mine_clr_restore_off_effect = yes
	remove_leader_flag = bgltp_mining_leader
}

# ==============================================================================
# MINING HARNESS: COUNTRY BEGIN / END, FLAG PRESETS, 9-LEVEL RUNNER
# ==============================================================================
bgltp_mine_begin_effect = {
	set_country_flag = bgltp_mining_active
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = bgltp_mine_seq } } set_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_seq value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_set = bgltp_mine_scen_id } } set_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_scen_id value = 0 } }
	if = {
		limit = { has_paragon_dlc = yes }
		set_country_code_flags = { autopick_leader_traits = yes }
	}
	log = "BGLTP_MINE_BEGIN seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] empire=[Root.GetName]"
	if = { limit = { has_paragon_dlc = yes } log = "BGLTP_MINE_META seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] paragon=yes" }
	else = { log = "BGLTP_MINE_META seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] paragon=no" }
	if = { limit = { is_gestalt = yes } log = "BGLTP_MINE_META seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] gestalt=yes" }
	else = { log = "BGLTP_MINE_META seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] gestalt=no" }
	if = { limit = { is_imperial_authority = yes } log = "BGLTP_MINE_META seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] imperial=yes" }
	else = { log = "BGLTP_MINE_META seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] imperial=no" }
	if = { limit = { is_megacorp = yes } log = "BGLTP_MINE_META seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] megacorp=yes" }
	else = { log = "BGLTP_MINE_META seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] megacorp=no" }
	if = { limit = { blocks_minister_of_state = yes } log = "BGLTP_MINE_META seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] blocks_minister_of_state=yes" }
	else = { log = "BGLTP_MINE_META seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] blocks_minister_of_state=no" }
}

bgltp_mine_end_effect = {
	log = "BGLTP_MINE_END seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scens=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id]"
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mining_active
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_orig_gov
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_orig_c
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_c_nomadic
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_block_flag
}

	add_skill = 1 $DIFF$ = yes

# Ship/fleet helpers (Fleet scope, Root = Country)
bgltp_mine_ship_combat_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { root = { country_uses_bio_ships = yes } }
		create_ship = { name = "BGLTP_TMP" random_existing_design = mauler_stage_1 }
		if = { limit = { num_ships < 1 } create_ship = { name = "BGLTP_TMP" random_existing_design = weaver_stage_1 } }
	}
	else = {
		create_ship = { name = "BGLTP_TMP" random_existing_design = corvette }
		if = { limit = { num_ships < 1 } create_ship = { name = "BGLTP_TMP" random_existing_design = destroyer } }
		if = { limit = { num_ships < 1 } create_ship = { name = "BGLTP_TMP" random_existing_design = cruiser } }
		if = { limit = { num_ships < 1 } create_ship = { name = "BGLTP_TMP" random_existing_design = battleship } }
		if = { limit = { num_ships < 1 } create_ship = { name = "BGLTP_TMP" random_existing_design = frigate } }
	}
	if = { limit = { num_ships < 1 } create_ship = { name = "BGLTP_TMP" random_existing_design = science } }
}

bgltp_mine_ship_science_effect = {
	create_ship = { name = "BGLTP_TMP" random_existing_design = science }
}

bgltp_mine_ship_transport_effect = {
	create_ship = { name = "BGLTP_TMP" random_existing_design = transport }
}

bgltp_mine_find_loc_effect = {
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok
	if = {
		limit = { exists = capital_scope }
		capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_loc }
		set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_owned_planet = { always = yes } }
		random_owned_planet = { save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_loc }
		set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_owned_fleet = { always = yes } }
		random_owned_fleet = { save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_loc }
		set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# OCCUPATION SCENARIO RUNNERS (Scope: Country / Root)
# ==============================================================================

bgltp_mine_scen_idle_effect = {
	change_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_scen_id value = 1 }
	log = "BGLTP_MINE_SCEN id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ class=$CLASS$ occ=idle flags=$FLAGS$ mode=$MODE$ n=$COUNT$"
	while = {
		count = $COUNT$
		create_leader = {
			name = random
			species = owner_main_species
			class = $CLASS$
			skill = 1
			randomize_traits = no
			hide_leader = yes
			skip_background_generation = no
			effect = {
				set_leader_flag = bgltp_mining_leader
				save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_leader
			}
		}
		event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = {
			$FLAG_EFFECT$ = yes
			bgltp_mine_strip_all_effect = yes
			bgltp_mine_level_9_effect = { DIFF = $DIFF$ }
			kill_leader = { show_notification = no fire = yes }
		}
	}
}

bgltp_mine_scen_fleet_effect = {
	change_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_scen_id value = 1 }
	log = "BGLTP_MINE_SCEN id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ class=$CLASS$ occ=$OCC$ flags=$FLAGS$ mode=$MODE$ n=$COUNT$"
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
	bgltp_mine_find_loc_effect = yes
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok } }
		log = "BGLTP_MINE_SKIP id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ reason=no_location"
	}
	else = {
		create_fleet = {
			name = "BGLTP_MINE_FLT"
			effect = {
				set_owner = root
				$SHIP_SETUP$ = yes
				set_location = event_target:bgltp_mine_loc
				save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_fleet
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { event_target:bgltp_mine_fleet = { num_ships < 1 } }
			log = "BGLTP_MINE_SKIP id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ reason=no_ship_design"
		}
		else = {
			while = {
				count = $COUNT$
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen } }
					create_leader = {
						name = random
						species = owner_main_species
						class = $CLASS$
						skill = 1
						randomize_traits = no
						hide_leader = yes
						skip_background_generation = no
						effect = {
							set_leader_flag = bgltp_mining_leader
							save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_leader
						}
					}
					event_target:bgltp_mine_fleet = { assign_leader = event_target:bgltp_mine_leader }
					if = {
						limit = { event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = { NOT = { exists = fleet } } }
						set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
						log = "BGLTP_MINE_SKIP id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ reason=fleet_assign_failed"
					}
					else = {
						event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = {
							$FLAG_EFFECT$ = yes
							bgltp_mine_strip_all_effect = yes
							bgltp_mine_level_9_effect = { DIFF = $DIFF$ }
						}
					}
					event_target:bgltp_mine_fleet = { unassign_leader = this }
					event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = { kill_leader = { show_notification = no fire = yes } }
				}
			}
		}
		delete_fleet = { target = event_target:bgltp_mine_fleet kill_leader = no }
		remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
	}
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok
}

bgltp_mine_scen_army_effect = {
	change_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_scen_id value = 1 }
	log = "BGLTP_MINE_SCEN id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ class=commander occ=army flags=$FLAGS$ mode=$MODE$ n=$COUNT$"
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok
	if = {
		limit = { exists = capital_scope }
		capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_planet }
		set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_owned_planet = { always = yes } }
		random_owned_planet = { save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_planet }
		set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok } }
		log = "BGLTP_MINE_SKIP id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ reason=no_planet_for_army"
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = last_created_army }
			last_created_army = {
				set_army_flag = bgltp_mine_not_ours
				save_event_target_as = bgltp_prev_last_army
			}
		}
		event_target:bgltp_mine_planet = {
			if = {
				limit = { root = { is_machine_empire = yes } }
				create_army = { name = "BGLTP_TMP_ARMY" owner = root species = root.owner_main_species type = "machine_assault_1" }
			}
			else = {
				create_army = { name = "BGLTP_TMP_ARMY" owner = root species = root.owner_main_species type = "assault_army" }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = last_created_army
				last_created_army = {
					NOT = { has_army_flag = bgltp_mine_not_ours }
					owner = { is_same_value = root }
				}
			}
			last_created_army = {
				set_army_flag = bgltp_mine_tmp_army
				save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_army
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { any_owned_army = { has_army_flag = bgltp_mine_tmp_army } } }
			if = {
				limit = { exists = last_created_army }
				last_created_army = {
					set_army_flag = bgltp_mine_not_ours
					save_event_target_as = bgltp_prev_last_army2
				}
			}
			event_target:bgltp_mine_planet = {
				create_army = { name = "BGLTP_TMP_ARMY" owner = root type = "sentinel_army" }
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = last_created_army
					last_created_army = {
						NOT = { has_army_flag = bgltp_mine_not_ours }
						owner = { is_same_value = root }
					}
				}
				last_created_army = {
					set_army_flag = bgltp_mine_tmp_army
					save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_army
				}
			}
		}
		every_country = {
			limit = { any_owned_army = { has_army_flag = bgltp_mine_not_ours } }
			every_owned_army = {
				limit = { has_army_flag = bgltp_mine_not_ours }
				remove_army_flag = bgltp_mine_not_ours
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { any_owned_army = { has_army_flag = bgltp_mine_tmp_army } } }
			log = "BGLTP_MINE_SKIP id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ reason=army_create_failed"
		}
		else = {
			while = {
				count = $COUNT$
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen } }
					create_leader = {
						name = random
						species = owner_main_species
						class = commander
						skill = 1
						randomize_traits = no
						hide_leader = yes
						skip_background_generation = no
						effect = {
							set_leader_flag = bgltp_mining_leader
							save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_leader
						}
					}
					event_target:bgltp_mine_army = { assign_leader = event_target:bgltp_mine_leader }
					if = {
						limit = {
							NOT = {
								any_owned_army = {
									has_army_flag = bgltp_mine_tmp_army
									exists = leader
									leader = { is_same_value = event_target:bgltp_mine_leader }
								}
							}
						}
						set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
						log = "BGLTP_MINE_SKIP id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ reason=army_assign_failed"
					}
					else = {
						event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = {
							$FLAG_EFFECT$ = yes
							bgltp_mine_strip_all_effect = yes
							bgltp_mine_level_9_effect = { DIFF = $DIFF$ }
						}
					}
					event_target:bgltp_mine_army = { unassign_leader = this }
					event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = { kill_leader = { show_notification = no fire = yes } }
				}
			}
			every_owned_army = {
				limit = { has_army_flag = bgltp_mine_tmp_army }
				remove_army = yes
			}
		}
		remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
	}
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok
}

bgltp_mine_scen_gov_effect = {
	change_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_scen_id value = 1 }
	log = "BGLTP_MINE_SCEN id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ class=$CLASS$ occ=gov flags=$FLAGS$ mode=$MODE$ n=$COUNT$"
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_orig_gov
	if = {
		limit = { exists = capital_scope }
		capital_scope = { save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_planet }
		set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { any_owned_planet = { always = yes } }
		random_owned_planet = { save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_planet }
		set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok } }
		log = "BGLTP_MINE_SKIP id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ reason=no_owned_planet"
	}
	else = {
		event_target:bgltp_mine_planet = {
			if = {
				limit = { exists = leader }
				leader = { save_event_target_as = bgltp_orig_gov }
				root = { set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_orig_gov }
			}
		}
		while = {
			count = $COUNT$
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen } }
				create_leader = {
					name = random
					species = owner_main_species
					class = $CLASS$
					skill = 1
					randomize_traits = no
					hide_leader = yes
					skip_background_generation = no
					effect = {
						set_leader_flag = bgltp_mining_leader
						save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_leader
					}
				}
				event_target:bgltp_mine_planet = { assign_leader = event_target:bgltp_mine_leader }
				if = {
					limit = { event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = { NOT = { exists = planet } } }
					set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
					log = "BGLTP_MINE_SKIP id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ reason=gov_assign_failed"
				}
				else = {
					event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = {
						$FLAG_EFFECT$ = yes
						bgltp_mine_strip_all_effect = yes
						bgltp_mine_level_9_effect = { DIFF = $DIFF$ }
					}
				}
				event_target:bgltp_mine_planet = { unassign_leader = this }
				event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = { kill_leader = { show_notification = no fire = yes } }
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_orig_gov }
			event_target:bgltp_mine_planet = { assign_leader = event_target:bgltp_orig_gov }
			remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_orig_gov
		}
		remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
	}
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_loc_ok
}

bgltp_mine_scen_council_effect = {
	change_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_scen_id value = 1 }
	log = "BGLTP_MINE_SCEN id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ class=$CLASS$ occ=council flags=$FLAGS$ mode=$MODE$ n=$COUNT$"
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_orig_c
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_c_nomadic
	if = {
		limit = { is_gestalt = yes }
		log = "BGLTP_MINE_SKIP id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ reason=gestalt_uses_nodes"
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { is_nomadic = yes }
			set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_c_nomadic
			random_owned_leader = {
				limit = { is_councilor_type = $POS_NOM$ }
				save_event_target_as = bgltp_orig_c
				prev = { set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_orig_c }
			}
		}
		else = {
			random_owned_leader = {
				limit = { is_councilor_type = $POS$ }
				save_event_target_as = bgltp_orig_c
				prev = { set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_orig_c }
			}
		}
		while = {
			count = $COUNT$
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen } }
				create_leader = {
					name = random
					species = owner_main_species
					class = $CLASS$
					skill = 1
					randomize_traits = no
					hide_leader = yes
					skip_background_generation = no
					effect = {
						set_leader_flag = bgltp_mining_leader
						save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_leader
					}
				}
				event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = {
					if = {
						limit = { root = { has_country_flag = bgltp_mine_c_nomadic } }
						set_council_position = $POS_NOM$
					}
					else = {
						set_council_position = $POS$
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = {
							OR = {
								is_councilor = no
								is_ruler = yes
							}
						}
					}
					set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
					log = "BGLTP_MINE_SKIP id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ reason=no_council_slot"
				}
				else = {
					event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = {
						$FLAG_EFFECT$ = yes
						bgltp_mine_strip_all_effect = yes
						bgltp_mine_level_9_effect = { DIFF = $DIFF$ }
					}
				}
				event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = {
					if = { limit = { is_councilor = yes } remove_from_empire_council = yes }
					kill_leader = { show_notification = no fire = yes }
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_orig_c }
			event_target:bgltp_orig_c = {
				if = {
					limit = { root = { has_country_flag = bgltp_mine_c_nomadic } }
					set_council_position = $POS_NOM$
				}
				else = {
					set_council_position = $POS$
				}
			}
			remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_orig_c
		}
		remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_c_nomadic
		remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
	}
}

bgltp_mine_scen_ruler_effect = {
	change_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_scen_id value = 1 }
	log = "BGLTP_MINE_SCEN id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ class=$CLASS$ occ=ruler flags=$FLAGS$ mode=$MODE$ n=$COUNT$"
	remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				is_gestalt = yes
				NOT = { exists = ruler }
			}
		}
		log = "BGLTP_MINE_SKIP id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ reason=gestalt_or_no_ruler"
	}
	else = {
		ruler = { save_event_target_as = bgltp_orig_ruler }
		while = {
			count = $COUNT$
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen } }
				create_leader = {
					name = random
					species = owner_main_species
					class = $CLASS$
					skill = 1
					randomize_traits = no
					hide_leader = yes
					skip_background_generation = no
					effect = {
						set_leader_flag = bgltp_mining_leader
						save_event_target_as = bgltp_mine_leader
					}
				}
				assign_leader = event_target:bgltp_mine_leader
				if = {
					limit = { event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = { is_ruler = no } }
					set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
					log = "BGLTP_MINE_SKIP id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$ reason=ruler_assign_failed"
				}
				else = {
					event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = {
						$FLAG_EFFECT$ = yes
						bgltp_mine_strip_all_effect = yes
						bgltp_mine_level_9_effect = { DIFF = $DIFF$ }
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = { event_target:bgltp_orig_ruler = { is_ruler = no } }
					assign_leader = event_target:bgltp_orig_ruler
				}
				event_target:bgltp_mine_leader = { kill_leader = { show_notification = no fire = yes } }
			}
		}
		remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_abort_scen
	}
}

# Existing non-spawnable leader miner (Leader scope, Root = Country)
bgltp_mine_existing_leader_effect = {
	set_leader_flag = bgltp_mining_leader
	bgltp_mine_snapshot_orig_effect = yes

	# Pass 1: clean baseline
	root = { change_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_scen_id value = 1 } }
	log = "BGLTP_MINE_SCEN id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$_clean class=$CLASS$ occ=$OCC$ flags=clean mode=clean n=$CLEAN_N$"
	while = {
		count = $CLEAN_N$
		bgltp_mine_level_9_effect = { DIFF = bgltp_mine_diff_existing_clean_effect }
	}

	# Pass 2: with occupation block flag (e.g. block_council_traits / block_galcom_traits / block_federation_traits)
	root = { change_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_scen_id value = 1 } remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_block_flag }
	if = { limit = { has_leader_flag = $BLOCK_FLAG$ } root = { set_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_block_flag } }
	set_leader_flag = $BLOCK_FLAG$
	log = "BGLTP_MINE_SCEN id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$_$BLOCK_FLAG$ class=$CLASS$ occ=$OCC$ flags=$BLOCK_FLAG$ mode=clean n=$FLAG_N$"
	while = {
		count = $FLAG_N$
		bgltp_mine_level_9_effect = { DIFF = bgltp_mine_diff_existing_clean_effect }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { root = { NOT = { has_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_block_flag } } }
		remove_leader_flag = $BLOCK_FLAG$
	}
	root = { remove_country_flag = bgltp_mine_had_block_flag }

	# Pass 3: progression from original traits + levels 1..10
	root = { change_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_scen_id value = 1 } }
	log = "BGLTP_MINE_SCEN id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=$SCEN$_prog class=$CLASS$ occ=$OCC$ flags=clean mode=prog n=1"
	bgltp_mine_level_9_effect = { DIFF = bgltp_mine_diff_prog_effect }

	bgltp_mine_cleanup_existing_effect = yes
}

	bgltp_mine_scen_gov_effect = { SCEN = cmd_gov CLASS = commander FLAGS = clean FLAG_EFFECT = bgltp_mine_flags_clean_effect MODE = clean DIFF = bgltp_mine_diff_strip_effect COUNT = $BASE_N$ }

bgltp_mine_suite_existing_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { exists = ruler }
		ruler = {
			if = {
				limit = { root = { is_gestalt = yes } }
				if = { limit = { leader_class = commander } bgltp_mine_existing_leader_effect = { SCEN = existing_gestalt_ruler CLASS = commander OCC = gestalt_ruler BLOCK_FLAG = block_council_traits CLEAN_N = 4 FLAG_N = 3 } }
				else_if = { limit = { leader_class = scientist } bgltp_mine_existing_leader_effect = { SCEN = existing_gestalt_ruler CLASS = scientist OCC = gestalt_ruler BLOCK_FLAG = block_council_traits CLEAN_N = 4 FLAG_N = 3 } }
				else = { bgltp_mine_existing_leader_effect = { SCEN = existing_gestalt_ruler CLASS = official OCC = gestalt_ruler BLOCK_FLAG = block_council_traits CLEAN_N = 4 FLAG_N = 3 } }
			}
			else = {
				if = { limit = { leader_class = commander } bgltp_mine_existing_leader_effect = { SCEN = existing_ind_ruler CLASS = commander OCC = existing_ruler BLOCK_FLAG = block_council_traits CLEAN_N = 2 FLAG_N = 2 } }
				else_if = { limit = { leader_class = scientist } bgltp_mine_existing_leader_effect = { SCEN = existing_ind_ruler CLASS = scientist OCC = existing_ruler BLOCK_FLAG = block_council_traits CLEAN_N = 2 FLAG_N = 2 } }
				else = { bgltp_mine_existing_leader_effect = { SCEN = existing_ind_ruler CLASS = official OCC = existing_ruler BLOCK_FLAG = block_council_traits CLEAN_N = 2 FLAG_N = 2 } }
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_owned_leader = { is_councilor_type = councilor_gestalt_legion } }
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = { is_councilor_type = councilor_gestalt_legion }
			bgltp_mine_existing_leader_effect = { SCEN = node_legion CLASS = commander OCC = gestalt_node BLOCK_FLAG = block_council_traits CLEAN_N = 4 FLAG_N = 3 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_owned_leader = { is_councilor_type = councilor_gestalt_cognitive } }
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = { is_councilor_type = councilor_gestalt_cognitive }
			bgltp_mine_existing_leader_effect = { SCEN = node_cognitive CLASS = scientist OCC = gestalt_node BLOCK_FLAG = block_council_traits CLEAN_N = 4 FLAG_N = 3 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_owned_leader = { is_councilor_type = councilor_gestalt_regulatory } }
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = { is_councilor_type = councilor_gestalt_regulatory }
			bgltp_mine_existing_leader_effect = { SCEN = node_regulatory CLASS = official OCC = gestalt_node BLOCK_FLAG = block_council_traits CLEAN_N = 4 FLAG_N = 3 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_owned_leader = { is_councilor_type = councilor_gestalt_growth } }
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = { is_councilor_type = councilor_gestalt_growth }
			bgltp_mine_existing_leader_effect = { SCEN = node_growth CLASS = official OCC = gestalt_node BLOCK_FLAG = block_council_traits CLEAN_N = 4 FLAG_N = 3 }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_owned_leader = { leader_class = official is_assigned_to_galcom = yes } }
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = { leader_class = official is_assigned_to_galcom = yes }
			bgltp_mine_existing_leader_effect = { SCEN = existing_galcom_delegate CLASS = official OCC = galcom BLOCK_FLAG = block_galcom_traits CLEAN_N = 4 FLAG_N = 3 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		change_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_scen_id value = 1 }
		log = "BGLTP_MINE_SCEN id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=existing_galcom_delegate class=official occ=galcom flags=clean mode=clean n=0"
		log = "BGLTP_MINE_SKIP id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=existing_galcom_delegate reason=no_galcom_delegate_assigned"
	}
	if = {
		limit = { any_owned_leader = { leader_class = official is_assigned_to_federation = yes } }
		random_owned_leader = {
			limit = { leader_class = official is_assigned_to_federation = yes }
			bgltp_mine_existing_leader_effect = { SCEN = existing_fed_delegate CLASS = official OCC = federation BLOCK_FLAG = block_federation_traits CLEAN_N = 4 FLAG_N = 3 }
		}
	}
	else = {
		change_variable = { which = bgltp_mine_scen_id value = 1 }
		log = "BGLTP_MINE_SCEN id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=existing_fed_delegate class=official occ=federation flags=clean mode=clean n=0"
		log = "BGLTP_MINE_SKIP id=[Root.bgltp_mine_scen_id] seq=[Root.bgltp_mine_seq] scen=existing_fed_delegate reason=no_fed_delegate_assigned"
	}
}
